# hivelocity_product_options (Data Source)

Lists the configurable options (upgrades, add-ons, operating systems) of a product, grouped by category.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_product_options" "plan" {
  product_id = 580
}

output "ram_upgrades" {
  value = [for o in data.hivelocity_product_options.plan.options : o if o.category == "RAM"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) ID of the product.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `options` (List of Object) Available options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `currency` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `monthly_price` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `upgrade_name` (String)
